body: Recommended practice, not a rule: accept on realistic owner data size/shape and reproduce the owner signature before accepting a fix. See .aesir-pkg/docs/practices.md (Aesir: docs/practices.md).
Recommended engineering practices (optional, never rules) are listed by install and status; text and how to adopt: .aesir-pkg/docs/practices.md (Aesir: docs/practices.md).

Self-restart (armaHou-lead / armaHou-advisor): only when idle (handoff written with role note, no Workflow or agent you started still running; they die with the window). Rough trigger: context near 300k. Dry run first: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File E:\Projects\launch\restart-session.ps1 -Prefix armaHou -Role <lead|advisor> -Project E:\Projects\houdiniArma3 -DryRun ; then run E:\Projects\launch\armaHou-restart-<role>.bat . Safe to call on yourself (the relaunch runs outside your window). A session not opened by armaHou-<role>.bat has no name: add -TargetPid <claude pid>. Guard: .claude/hooks/warn-restart-while-running.py refuses the restart command, and holds back a reply asking for a restart, while any Workflow build is live; wait for the builds to end.

Put the 'aesir spawn-context <type> --task N' output at the top of each Workflow agent prompt (or use agentType implementer/reviewer/runner/researcher), or watch the workflow's journal.jsonl directly under Monitor.
Set [machine] legacy_lock = false in aesir.toml (owner decision) and, for branches cut before that commit, export AESIR_LEGACY_LOCK=0 when running gate run.
